title: Adapted Wasserstein Barycenters of Gaussian Processes
summary: We study barycenters of filtered Gaussian processes in adapted Wasserstein space. The adapted Wasserstein distance refines classical optimal transport by requiring transport plans to respect the temporal flow of information, making it the natural metric for stochastic systems with filtration constraints, as in stochastic control, mathematical finance, and sequential decision problems.
